■ Direction
Astonished, but a feeling of joy slowly wells up

Building a theory, constructing equations, deriving the answer...
I shall fight through my races with my very own "Winning Formula"!

Aw, don't cry! There, there.
Look, big sis will teach you the secret!

...Trainer.
Allow me to carve your name into the opening page.

Mysterious and seemingly always cool-headed, Biwa Hayahide
held such burning passion deep within her heart.
I'm begging you! Just hear me out!

D-Does that mean...?! 
Wait, but I haven't completely made up my mind yet...

If raw ability falls short, compensate with meticulous planning.
If training time is limited, maximize efficiency to the absolute peak.
Yeah, looks legit!
...We made a promise.

She might not even remember it anymore... but that doesn't matter.
As an older sister, and as a fellow Umamusume, one day without fail—

Yet... she'd always chase after me, saying,
"Running with you is fun!" and "I love racing!"

...I appreciate the offer, but I have yet to make up my mind.
Therefore, I must respectfully decline.

Heh, though I'm still a work in progress.
I haven't reached the caliber to stand alongside Brian just yet.

Big sis, wait for meee~!!
Haa, haa...

And with my perfected "formula for victory,"
I will... defeat Brian!
...With "the older sister."
A few days after the Debut Race Selection...

(The Sprout Memorial...! That race where only the most
highly anticipated Umamusume up to the Junior Class earn a spot...?!)

Though it seems today, I will need to
add one important thing to it.

Biwa Hayahide smiled and walked away,
but there seemed to be a lingering shadow behind her expression.

Did you follow me?
...Heh, between this and the glasses, you really are quite softhearted.
...I only wish I could have stayed that "proud older sister" forever.
Like I care...

And her theory-driven racing...
I felt like I had glimpsed a new potential for Umamusume there...!
Worried about her, I decided to follow after her...

...Ever since back then, we've aimed for the Twinkle Series.
Just Brian and me, together.

Especially in terms of physical ability, a gap opened between us in no time.
Power, speed, stamina... she's exceptional in every single metric.

...She's my "pride and joy of a little sister."
She may seem standoffish now, but she's an earnest, darling girl.
In the first place, are you sure about this?

Don't say that. Getting scouted before selection
is proof of how high expectations are for you.

To anyone's eyes, Brian is... "extraordinary."
In time, she'll become a "monster" on par with President Symboli Rudolf.

Eeeek, that's insane...! Isn't it practically unheard of
for an Umamusume to be chosen before even debuting!?

With me, I can guide you all the way to the Triple Crown!
My passion is second to none! Please, "monster" Brian!

Oh, Biwa Hayahide, if you'd like to join too!
Would you consider our team? Siblings pushing each other to the top are always welcome!
To run the greatest race together with my sister on the stage of the Twinkle Series.

(Mm... what's this? I'm hearing Brian's name
even more than usual...)
Huh!? Hey, if you're leaving, at least deal with these guys first—!

I resolved right then to formulate the ultimate "formula for victory"
together with this cool-headed girl—and lead her to triumph.
...You just keep getting further and further ahead of me, don't you?

I was always by her side... and that's why I felt it firsthand.
How my sister... "Narita Brian's" sheer abnormality began to rear its head.

—That's why I needed a weapon.
A weapon different from Brian's.
Brian-senpai really is built different, isn't she?!

Yes. ...When we were young, we'd play tag in parks like this every day.
Back then, I was the faster one, and being such a sore loser, she'd cry all the time.
Well then. ...Do your best out there, Brian.

*sniff* I don't wanna anymore...
I wanna zoom fast like you, big sis...

Tch... What a pain.
I haven't even run my selection race yet.

Ahahaha! Come on, hurry up!
The goal is just ahead~!

—So the rumors are actually true!?
That Brian-senpai is running in the Sprout Memorial...!
...Huh? What did you just say?

Our support system is top-notch! What do you say, Brian?!
We'll respect your natural physical gifts and your wishes above all else!

I came upon the sisters, Biwa Hayahide
and Narita Brian, surrounded by Trainers.

This notebook contains numerous theories currently in development.
Naturally, that includes the "formula for victory" as well.
And so, I signed a Trainer contract with Biwa Hayahide.

Hm... you're...
Come to think of it, you were watching us from afar earlier—
A few days later—
That is precisely why...!!
